source: **Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected because it is specifically optimized for whole-brain immunolabeling with superior antibody penetration, which is critical for detecting endogenous c-Fos expression (a marker for neuronal activation) throughout the entire 10 mm adult mouse brain. It achieves high transparency and is compatible with light-sheet microscopy, allowing for the reconstruction of single-cell resolution 3D maps. The use of Alexa Fluor 647 provides deep tissue penetration and minimal autofluorescence, while DAPI serves as a nuclear counterstain for anatomical registration.
english: **Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected because it is specifically optimized for whole-brain immunolabeling with superior antibody penetration, which is critical for detecting endogenous c-Fos expression (a marker for neuronal activation) throughout the entire 10 mm adult mouse brain. It achieves high transparency and is compatible with light-sheet microscopy, allowing for the reconstruction of single-cell resolution 3D maps. The use of Alexa Fluor 647 provides deep tissue penetration and minimal autofluorescence, while DAPI serves as a nuclear counterstain for anatomical registration.
